title: v0.1.0 — the first release whose numbers you can check
body:
**[v0.1.0 · the harness](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/releases/tag/v0.1.0)** is tagged.

Ten notebooks, a from-scratch toolkit, an eval gate that blocks a merge on a metric regression,
12 auto-graded labs, and a documentation site at
[akash-coded.github.io/nanorag](https://akash-coded.github.io/nanorag/).

## What is worth your attention

**Three measurements that contradict the material, kept rather than tuned away.** RRF losing to
weighted fusion, comparison starvation not reproducing, and no retrieval-score threshold separating
answerable from unanswerable. Each carries **how to re-test it** and **the number that would
falsify it** — see the README.

**A fourth was added after a discussion thread**: the learned reranker made retrieval *worse at
every k*, because a reranker over the same signals as the first stage is an expensive identity
function.

**Eight ADRs, each with a falsifier.** "What would change this" is a required section. A decision
without one is a preference.

## What this release does not claim

Every number here was measured on a **synthetic corpus this repository generated itself**. That
choice is deliberate — gold labels are true by construction, so there is no annotation-error floor
under any result — and it means **every finding has an untested precondition**.

[The extension project](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/70-extension/README.md) exists to find out which
of them survive contact with real data. `E0`–`E6`, 17 issues, and a board field with three values:
`reproduced`, `contradicted`, `inconclusive`.

**Contradicted is the most valuable outcome.** It would say precisely what a synthetic corpus
cannot teach, which is a thing almost nobody writes down.

## Where to start

| You are | Start |
|---|---|
| new here | [`docs/00-orientation/start-here.md`](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/00-orientation/start-here.md) |
| wanting to practise | [the L.A.B. simulator](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/80-lab/README.md) |
| preparing for an interview | [the question bank](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/interview-prep/README.md) |
| here for one page in a meeting | [the cheat sheets](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/tree/main/docs/60-cheatsheets) |

## If you find a number that does not reproduce

Open an `[errata]` thread in Q&A. That is the highest-value contribution anyone can make here, and
it has already happened once — [#85](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/discussions/85) caught this repository quoting the
Landis–Koch κ bands as though they were a standard.
